title: hypericum humifusum var. radicans
intro: Hypericum humifusum var. radicans, commonly known as creeping St. John's Wort, is a low-growing, spreading perennial plant native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum humifusum var. radicans include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, acting as an adaptogen, and displaying antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and naphthodianthrones, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
